speakers.headline: Audio Director and Founder
speakers.biographyMd: In 1999 Davide Pensato starts his career as in-house Audio DirectorSound Designer at Ubisoft Studios Milano. In a couple of years he is responsible of audio team. Both a creative and technical figure, he can create audio for a game as well as integrating it using software and hardware tools. In January 2007 creates his own company (dpstudios) offering consulting and services for game audio. He develops web and multimedia projects too, as a new activity branch.
